questions.question: osmotic pressure of 0.1 M CH3COOH (Ka = 10–5) solution is :

the degree of dissociation (α):
α = √(Ka / C)
α = √(10⁻⁵ / 0.1)
α = √(10⁻⁴)
α = 10⁻² = 0.01
the van't Hoff factor (i):
i = 1 + α(n - 1)
i = 1 + 0.01(2 - 1)
i = 1 + 0.01
i = 1.01
the osmotic pressure (π):
π = iCRT
π = (1.01) × (0.1 M) × RT
